notes.title: Dark Space - Ex Machina is out now!
Patch 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
Issues fixed:
[list]
[*] Better indication of selected UI elements
[*] Continue button hidden when no save game exists
[/list]

Features added/updated:
[list]
[*] Improvements to saving system
[*] Accessibility improvements for the first puzzle with boxes
[/list]


Thanks to everyone who report issues with the game.

If you find any bugs within the game please submit them using the "Report a bug or give feedback" option in the main menu. Or join the official Discord server and submit them in the bug-report section: https://discord.gg/skdV9Br

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Issues fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Audio volume and gamma sliders set to zero on first launch
[*] Chapter IV first level lighting fixed
[/list]

[b]Features added/updated:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated credits
[*] Save game widget
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who reported those issues.

If you find any bugs within the game please submit them using the "Report a bug or give feedback" option in the main menu. Or join the official Discord server and submit them in the bug-report section: https://discord.gg/skdV9Br

notes.title: Announcement for Beta testers
notes.content: Hi! I would like to announce that after April 26th all the beta keys will expire. Huge thanks to everyone who participated and provided me with invaluable feedback!
